project_info.theme: Toyota supports family dreams through sport and daily journeys
project_info.color_palette: Sky blue, sunset gold, white, field green, charcoal

main_subject.detail: A warm inspirational automotive poster featuring a white Toyota Innova Cross parked beside a football field at golden hour. On the right, a father and young boy in football kit walk away arm in arm toward the field, the child carrying a soccer ball and the father holding a sports duffel bag. A glowing football streaks across the top-right sky. Large headline text reads 'TIEP LUA DAM ME NUOI DUONG UOC MO'. Bottom-left script says 'Move your world'.
main_subject.style: Emotional family-sport lifestyle poster with cinematic sunset light, aspirational storytelling, and polished SUV hero framing

composition_elements.text: TOYOTA / TIEP LUA DAM ME / NUOI DUONG UOC MO / Move your world
items: Top Left: Toyota logo on a clear blue sky
Top Right: Glowing football with blue motion trail near the headline
Bottom Left: White Toyota Innova Cross parked on a paved edge beside the field and the handwritten slogan
Bottom Right: Father and child walking toward the field in warm backlight with long shadows
Center/Background: Golden-hour football field bordered by trees, with the headline floating above the scene

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Warm sun rays, long shadows, glossy car reflections, hopeful inspirational glow

technical_specs.render_style: Photoreal lifestyle automotive composite with cinematic emotional retouching

prompt.generated_prompt_string: High quality advertising poster for a Toyota family aspiration story centered on football dreams. Centerpiece is a white Toyota Innova Cross parked beside a grassy football field while a father and his son walk arm in arm toward practice, carrying a soccer ball and sports bag. Background is a bright sunset field with trees, long shadows, and a glowing football streaking through the sky. Surrounding elements: Toyota logo, exact headline 'TIEP LUA DAM ME NUOI DUONG UOC MO', and footer script 'Move your world'. Technical style: photoreal lifestyle automotive composite with cinematic emotional retouching, golden-hour family-lifestyle lighting, warm sun rays and glossy reflections, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
